name: Cserépváralja (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Cserépváralja: a blue and green shield with a white castle on a hill and a tile, above a green scroll inscribed CSERÉPVÁRALJA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
